title: Engine Wiring Audit & Dead Code Cleanup
description: Build engine dependency graph (static + dynamic references), identify truly dead engines vs indirectly-wired ones, remove confirmed dead code, sync index.ts header with actual export count. Gap analysis found 136/156 exported engines have no direct dispatcher import — most are indirectly wired but ~15-20 may be genuinely dead.
findings: 116-136 engines not directly imported by any dispatcher (87% of exports)
index.ts header claims 171 engines but only 156 unique modules export
WhiteLayerDetectionEngine never called by any code path
~212 physical .ts files in engines/ vs 156 barrel exports — 56 files not in index

units.title: Build Engine Dependency Graph

steps.instruction: Scan all dispatchers for direct engine imports (static import statements)
Scan all engines for engine-to-engine imports (internal wiring)
Scan for dynamic/string-based engine references in orchestration, swarm, and algorithm routing
Produce a JSON graph: { engine: string, importedBy: string[], importedByType: 'dispatcher'|'engine'|'dynamic' }[]
Classify each engine: WIRED (dispatcher), INTERNAL (engine-to-engine), DYNAMIC (string routing), ORPHANED (no references)

exit_conditions: Complete dependency graph JSON saved to state/SYS-MS4/engine-dependency-graph.json

steps.instruction: From the dependency graph, extract all ORPHANED engines
For each orphaned engine, do a final grep for any string reference (dynamic imports, config files, test files)
For confirmed dead engines (AlgorithmGatewayEngine, WhiteLayerDetectionEngine, others): remove from index.ts exports, move files to a deprecated/ folder or delete
For engines that exist on disk but aren't in index.ts: determine if they should be added to barrel or removed
Run TSC and full test suite to verify no regressions

units.title: Sync Index Header & Export Count

steps.instruction: Count actual unique exports in index.ts after dead code removal
Update index.ts header comment to match actual count
Update any CLAUDE.md files that reference engine counts
Update constants.ts ENGINE_COUNT if it exists

exit_conditions: All count references match actual export count

deliverables: Accurate engine counts across all docs
